posts.title: So I watched a couple of videos about Meal Kit services
posts.description: Why major meal kit companies lose 90% of customers in a year From the video: Americans only cook an average of 4.5 meals per week at home. Over the course of a decade, America went from 13 to 382 meal kit companies. Most lost 90 percent of new subscribers by the end of their first year and many struggle to be profitable. posts.title: Roasting Pumpkin Seeds
posts.description: It's October and pumpkins are in season. I'm not a fan of stuff like pumpkin pie, but if you are going to carve Jack-o'-lanterns, don't toss the seeds in the trash! Instead, separate them from the stringy orange stuff, lay them on a cookie sheet or similar, salt and roast on very low heat.
